raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified a Wikisource page for a different work (a Charles Wesley hymn with the same title) as likely containing Audre Lorde’s poem, instructing the WebSurfer to use it. This title-based conflation led the effort down an irrelevant source path, directly impeding progress toward identifying the correct stanza number.
